notes.title: Combat
notes.notes:
We would like to highlight the combat movement in Avenging Angel. 

The STRAFING and DODGING were not part of EA, and when we brought those along, we, based on the feedback from the test players, thought that the game was too easy. The strafing and dodging enabled test players to "dance" around the melee enemies, at least in bigger environment, without receiving one single hit. 

As we listened to feedback, it became pretty obvious, that this wasn't the whole truth. There are clearly those who wish for a more casual experience and then those who really enjoy a more hard-core on-the-edge-of-your-seat experience. 

The default game mode is now "normal" as before, but it denotes an easier game. "Hard" is now the difficulty level the game was released with and intended to be played.

notes.title: v1.0.3
notes.notes:
v1.0.3

- The default difficulty level has been now set to “Casual”, and the “Hard” mode must be activated from the main menu. 
- In the beginning of the game, the cutscene when landing to the platform at the outpost, some players have experienced a frame drop when the save system updates the save file. This is most likely due to antivirus application checking the autosave write process. This is now concealed. 
- A new weapon can now be crafted in the beginning of the game. The blueprint and ALL the necessary ingredients can be found at the Outpost. 
- Workbench functions are now updated and weapon crafting bug, that some players experienced, is now fixed. The ESC/B-button will now force the workbench GUI to close, regardless of input scheme.
- Statue Forest Turnstile platforming is now made easier.
- Player character damage input system and player character damage indicator in Goggle Glass is updated.

notes.title: Full Release
notes.notes:
Avenging Angel has now been fully released. 

Thank you each and every one of you who have supported us throughout the years. 

We are painfully aware that this took a lot longer than we anticipated, but we have essentially redone the entire game. That means all graphical assets, animations, foley, and music. Everything. We brought in a lot of new features such as status effects, a lot more varied weapons, new enemies, and new areas.

We sincerely hope you enjoy the game.

Release candidate has been in Beta Channel for a few weeks for testing. We are releasing on June 15th 2018 at 9 PM CET. 

https://youtu.be/u28Y-rnEiO8

notes.title: Breaking the silence
notes.notes:
Greetings ladies and gentlemen.

We have been on a hiatus for some time now due to health related issues. Two (that's two out of three) of the team members have been gravely ill (no, not the flu kind, but life threatening and incapacitating kind). Honestly, we were not sure whether we could continue the development until everyone was in full health. We are sorry for the delay and silence, but please believe, we had little choice. 

All that being said, we are gearing up now. 

Avenging Angel Arena Stand Alone Single Player edition is available for download at http://www.avengingangelgame.com/demo/ 

It also portrays new graphics and controller support (struggled hard with that one, Xbox 360 Controller and DS4 are now fully supported as plug & play) and all the new weapons, which will be available in Pain & Despair update. We have also brought new enemies from the update to the Arena as well. 

We will bring Avenging Angel Arena into steam in a few weeks and we are currently porting it also to LINUX. This will be an experimental alpha build, but we are seriously bringing Avenging Angel to Steam OS as well, and this is the first step towards that direction.  Both versions will be in available eventually in Steam.

We will now continue our work with Pain & Despair update and we hope to bring it to you before Christmas. 

Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: Guns of Summer!
notes.notes:
Hello all! We are now planning the next big content update for Avenging Angel a bit later in this Summer. Here is what you can expect:

[b]New guns:[/b]

These can be dual-wielded with the already existing weapons:
- Katana
- Rapid Fire Flintlocks
- Shotgun
- Vincent's unique Gun Blade

Two-handed weapon:
- Railgun/sniper rifle

You can see the designs on our [url=https://www.facebook.com/avengingangelgame/posts/923310827729554] Facebook page[/url]. 


[b]A completely new area beneath the forest leading to another part of the Island topside.[/b] This will be a part of a new side quest which will open the "Memorial" near the lake. This side quest will also enable island topside fast travel between certain locations. Also expect at least one new NPC. As a reward for this side quest, a set of unique weapons will be added, which can be only obtained by completing this quest. 

[b]New soundtrack and music[/b]. A completely new soundtrack and playlist system.

[b]UPDATE[/b]
We can now also confirm:
- Wildlife 
- Collectible plant ingredients for Alchemy in the forest
- New Goggle Glass upgrades
- New weapon upgrades and power ups 
- Lots more weapon parts for crafting

[b]We will let you know in early July when this update will be available. [/b]  

We see you all and we hear you all. 

- Dark Amber Crew

notes.title: Next Patch June 15th
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Based on the feedback and bug reporting, we will be patching the game on Monday June 15th. 

Besides the normal bug crushing and optimisation for better performance, here is what is new:

- The Statue Forest area performance should be better. Some folks have experienced the game crashing between "Outpost" and "Statue Forest" (1st and 2nd area). The forest area is really, really big and we attempt to solve the issue by queuing assets differently and we are looking into memory allocation as well. 

- The Hangar autosave point has been re-adjusted and death trigger at the Hangar has been removed.

- Controller support should be better. DS4 should work with USB and Bluetooth. After the update, we will also post a screenshot of DS4 settings we know will work. 

Thank you all for playing, your support, criticism, and feedback. 

We see you all and we hear you all.

-Dark Amber Crew

notes.title: Game update today (Monday June 8th)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. A new update to the game just went live! Here's what's new:

Player Character controls are re-defined. Those of you who experienced trouble with DS4, this update should fix that. Unfortunately 360 controller does not work in menus, but gameplay should be now good.

Statue Forest area has been optimised and should run now smoother.

Enemy stats regarding "Arnold" 1881-A1 have now been re-adjusted. The direct fire from the gatling gun will still hurt, but the robot should bite the dust a bit easier. Fear not, it still a challenge.

Grenade launcher ammo now stays in the inventory. 

"Recipe disappearance bug" in workshop now fixxored.
